newsitem.title: USA: AmEx, Banco Popular, to launch card.
newsitem.headline: AmEx, Banco Popular, to launch card.

text.p: American Express Co said Monday Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, a unit of Popular Inc, will issue a general purpose revolving credit card on the American Express network.
The Banco Popular American Express Card will be available in Puerto Rico, the U.S. and British Virgin Islands and other Caribbbean locations in early 1998.
American Express said it was the first network agreement in the Caribbean and it represented an extension of the strategy of opening its network to other issuers.

"This new credit card will provide Banco Popular with the opportunity to strengthen its position as the leader in card products in Puerto Rico and the Caribbean, and is in tune with its expansion strategy in the region," Banco Popular president and chief executive Richard Carrion said in a statement.
The card will be accepted by all merchants on the American Express global network, the companies said.
Last week, American Express said San Jose, Costa Rica-based Credomatic would issue American Express cards in five Central American countries.
